# Test-FullBenchmarkMatrix.ps1

Precondition failures write a `not-executed` manifest under the requested artifact root before returning exit code `2`, so missing MFT capability is visible evidence rather than an unrecorded skip.

Runs every required BenchmarkDotNet suite as separate, auditable lanes and validates that each expected benchmark method has a successful full-compressed JSON result with statistics. The portable lanes cover one-million-node path reconstruction, large-folder moves, grouped/Event Stack/Period Diff, append and Zstandard work, SQLite rebuild/query, and external-media manifest/segment work. `-IncludeMft` is intended for a physical Windows host and read-only cross-checks an attached dynamic file-backed VHDX, disk number/unique ID, target NTFS volume unique ID/GUID/label, persistent seed marker/run GUID, protected system/pagefile/crash-dump roles, and host CPU/memory/OS facts. C: is rejected as a target but may contain the dedicated VHDX file. The benchmark evidence producer records these identities and actual MFT enumeration independently confirms at least one million entries. `-PortableOnly` is explicitly diagnostic and writes `AcceptanceEligible=false`.

The script does not replace `build/quality/Test-Performance.ps1`. It fails closed on missing/mismatched host/disk/volume/marker facts, protected target roles, BenchmarkDotNet errors, missing reports/methods, or incomplete correctness evidence. `StorageChronicle.MftBenchmarkEvidence.v1` is written to `STORAGE_CHRONICLE_MFT_EVIDENCE_PATH`; supply `-MftEvidencePath` (or use the default `WindowsMft/mft-evidence.json`). Each run writes a manifest and per-suite runner log below `artifacts/benchmarks/full-matrix-*`. **Currently MFT always remains `NOT_EXECUTED`: this ownership scope has no audited create-new VHDX/seed workflow that can prove the VHDX path was absent before creation under an approved isolation root. The runner intentionally stops before BenchmarkDotNet even if read-only identity checks pass.** No `-IncludeMft` run, disk query, or physical acceptance is implied by source-contract tests.

Relevant requirements: `Requirements/03_TEST_AND_QUALITY_REQUIREMENTS.md` §5 and §9, and `Requirements/19_AGENT_INTEGRATION_QUALITY.md` §4 and §6. The script's evidence is diagnostic/acceptance evidence only; it does not alter benchmark thresholds or product contracts.
